name: FuzeAgent Chat Streaming & Fuse Seam Design System
description: Redesign of FuzeAgent UX/UI in accordance with FuzeFront Design System tokens, inherited components, live streaming chat, modal dialog layout stability, high-contrast blueprint catalogs, and contextual portal dark/light theme switching. Managed and planned via FuzeX SaaS product workflow.

frames.label: (a) Real-Time Chat Streaming — LA Time
frames.summary: Demonstrates streaming assistant chat bubble with fuse seam glow, thought accordion, and live timezone card for Los Angeles.
frames.acceptanceNotes: WebSocket connection over /api/ws/multi-agent streams token chunks, displaying timezone response with live PDT clock and globe indicator.

frames.label: (b) Contextual Dark & Light Theme
frames.summary: Demonstrates contextual synchronization between FuzeFront portal theme and FuzeAgent inner workspace canvas.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Canvas dynamically reacts to data-theme attribute on documentElement and localStorage mutation, switching tokens without page refresh.

frames.label: (c) Active Sandboxes & Session Teardown
frames.summary: Lists active Kubernetes sandbox pods and provides graceful termination action.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Deleting or terminating session sends HTTP DELETE /api/agents/sandbox/{id} and frees pod and PVC resources cleanly.

frames.label: (d) Deploy New Agent Modal & Blueprint Selection
frames.summary: Prevents layout collapse by enforcing modal-overlay backdrop and modal-dialog panel with 2-column blueprint specifications.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Modal opens centered with backdrop blur, displays categorized blueprints, allows instance naming, and handles submit without collapsing into slivers.

frames.label: (e) Agent Blueprints & Templates Catalog
frames.summary: High-contrast catalog for discovering, inspecting, and deploying verified agent blueprints with category filters.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Luminous typography on hero banner, pill filters for role categories, and one-click launch CTAs.

frames.label: (f) Multi-Agent Task Assignment & Orchestration
frames.summary: Workload task assignment across deployed agent pods with priority tiers, memory context scopes, and real-time step streaming.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Task submission dispatches work across agent sandboxes and displays terminal progress telemetry in real time.
